chapter: Chapter VII: Positive Vector Bundles and Vanishing Theorems

examples.title: Kodaira Vanishing Theorem
examples.content: For an ample line bundle L on a compact Kahler manifold X of dimension n, the higher cohomology of L tensor the canonical bundle vanishes.

examples.title: Nakano Positivity
examples.content: A Hermitian vector bundle (E, h) is Nakano positive if its curvature tensor is positive as a Hermitian form on T_X tensor E.

simulator.title: Ample Line Bundle O(1)
simulator.description: The hyperplane bundle O(1) on CP^n is the prototypical ample line bundle with positive curvature.

applications.title: Algebraic Geometry
applications.description: Vanishing theorems are essential for proving existence of sections and embeddings.

applications.title: Complex Analysis
applications.description: Positivity of line bundles connects to plurisubharmonicity and pseudoconvexity.

concepts.name: Ample Line Bundle
concepts.definition: A line bundle L such that L^{tensor k} embeds X into projective space for large k.

concepts.name: Griffiths Positivity
concepts.definition: A bundle E is Griffiths positive if its curvature is positive on decomposable tensors.

exercises.question: Show that O(1) on CP^1 has positive curvature using the Fubini-Study metric.
exercises.hint: Compute the curvature form in the standard trivialization over C subset CP^1.

exercises.question: Prove that a Nakano positive bundle is Griffiths positive.
exercises.hint: Nakano positivity on decomposable tensors reduces to Griffiths positivity.

diagrams.title: Curvature Positivity
diagrams.description: Visualize how positive curvature creates convexity in the bundle metric.
diagrams.instructions: Positive curvature means geodesics in the bundle spread apart.
